title: Nothirium LittleTiles Patch
description: This mod is designed to fix the incompatibility between Nothirium and LittleTiles.
body:
This mod fixes compatibility issues between Nothirium and LittleTiles for Minecraft 1.12.2.

Without this fix, players may experience rendering glitches, crashes, or broken tile behavior when using both mods together. This project resolves those conflicts, allowing both mods to work smoothly in the same environment.

**Features**

Fixes rendering issues between Nothirium and LittleTiles
Prevents crashes related to their interaction
Ensures stable gameplay when both mods are installed
Why use this mod?

If you want to use Nothirium's performance improvements together with LittleTiles' building features, this mod makes it possible without errors or instability.

**Requirements**

Nothirium: [link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nothirium)

LittleTiles (1.12.2): [link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/littletiles)

MixinBooter: [link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter)
